archetypes.name: dyn-prompt-density
archetypes.rationale: Checks that shortened aggregator scaffolding preserves validator constraints.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changes in `python/larch/review/review_aggregate.py` that shorten aggregator prompt scaffolding. Focus on whether every prior validator constraint remains present for reviewer-slot preservation, OOS-only slots, and verbatim fix-text traceability. Also check that the raw-findings heading and scope-reduction notice remain clear for both plan and code aggregation paths. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
